cohort: The study included 260 antenatal patients of 29-40 weeks of gestation, comprising 130 pregnant women with pregnancy-induced hypertension and 130 normotensive pregnant women.
finding: The mean neutrophil-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) was significantly higher in pregnant women with pregnancy-induced hypertension (3.58+/-0.79) compared to normotensive pregnant women (2.38+/-0.58) (p <0.001), indicating an increased inflammatory response in hypertensive disorders of pregnancy.
